snippet.title: Final Upgrade Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Final Upgrade is a factory building sim featuring battles in space. You will play as an Artificially Intelligence, created by a big corporation to conquer deep space.

Sign up for closed alpha tests here:
Website: https://finalupgrade.net/

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/919260/Final_Upgrade/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/FinalUpgradeGam
Discord: https://discord.gg/tSD2KZM
